verdict.rationale: GitHub documents a first-party command-line interface for Copilot that runs directly in the terminal, with official install docs, voice prompting, and terminal support via GitHub CLI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the current CLI, and documented depth on its agentic or scripting capabilities (e.g. non-interactive automation).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The command-line interface (CLI) for GitHub Copilot allows you to use Copilot directly from your terminal.
GitHub Copilot is also supported in terminals through GitHub CLI
As an alternative to typing, you can speak your prompt.
